quote: My 9-year-old needed speed training and strength workouts, and Sam delivered exactly what we were looking for! quote: Working out with Sam at Strength for Today has been just what I needed to gain confidence and strength. Sam seems to know exactly what I need at just the right time. Thanks to his expertise and dedication, I’ve gotten stronger with weights and bands and achieved results I never thought possible.
name: Kim VanRoekel

quote: My daughter Abigail is a competitive swimmer. She is a two time State Champion and her next goal was to qualify to compete at a National level. Her commitment to training and technique were solid, but based on what we knew other athletes were doing in terms of training we knew the area that she needed additional support in was conditioning. This began our search for a program in our area. I found Strength for Today in a Google search. I had not heard of them, but was pleasantly surprised as I read about the program on Sam’s website. It seemed to be exactly what we were looking for. I reached out and we set up an appointment to meet with Sam and discuss Abigail’s goals. Abby began training with Sam in January and in March, she qualified for Junior Nationals! Within a few weeks we began noticing small changes. Abigail’s goal was to increase upper body strength and that definitely has happened. Sam tailors workouts to each athlete's needs, based on their sport and individual goals. He is encouraging, outgoing and supportive. He definitely works at building positive relationships with his athletes. Sam is willing to work around the crazy schedules of elite athletes and their parents which is amazing! Abigail loves going to SFT, she has seen the results from the work she has done. She appreciates Sam’s positivity and support. I would highly recommend Sam and Strength for Today if your athlete is seeking to take their performance to the next level. It certainly has been a contributing factor in Abigail’s swimming success!
name: Kelly Campbell

quote: I recently retired and was tired of the way I looked and felt.I saw too many people my age that retired, sat all day, and were miserable.I made a promise to myself that this was not going to be me.I had never really worked out before, but found out about Sam and decided to give it a try.That was the hardest part...making the commitment to start. Sam has developed a strength training program for me that pushes me just enough. He carefully listens to my feedback and makes adjustments when necessary.In three months I am down over 15 pounds, love the way I'm feeling and actually look forward to going every week. Oh and the music is awesome!!

quote: After I retired, I realized that if I wanted to travel and enjoy life after work, I needed to make some lifestyle changes, some of which included healthier eating and regular exercise. I highly recommend SFT to those of all ages who are looking for small group training with personalized attention in a supportive environment.

quote: I have strength trained intermittently throughout my adult life, but rarely with a real plan. He gives ample opportunity for feedback before planning each 4-week program. Sam always has a smile and makes each session a positive experience.

quote: Ben is a driven wrestler with some very lofty goals! We knew that achieving those goals would involve getting stronger in the ways that count the most on the mat. Finding Strength for Today has been such a blessing. Coach Sam has developed a specific strength training program that is built around Ben's needs and tailored specifically to his sport. In the last three months, Ben has gained quite a bit of strength, and it has shown on the mat. Beyond the strength training, Sam has helped instill a better work ethic, a healthier diet and the confidence that comes with great training. The coaches at SFT do a fantastic job of pushing Ben while encouraging him and helping him recognize the gains he has achieved. Ben truly values his time at SFT and never has to be pushed to get a workout in. If you are on the fence about joining SFT, I would encourage you to join today. Strength for Today has been a very positive experience for our student athlete!
name: Matt Armstrong
context: Atley Noort - Jerry Ross Elementary Football, Basebll

quote: Atley began a speed, strength and agility program when he was 9 at another facility. As time went on with the other facility, they seemed to have put more energy into the number of clients they could get rather than the quality of training they could offer. We ended up leaving and looking for another place. My cousin had mentioned his son, Jake Metzger, had been training with SFT and Sam for several months and was very happy! Atley is a very driven individual and loves how much he has been challenged by Sam. Every day when he gets to class he looks up at the board of record holders in his age group. He uses this for fuel to push himself to become the best he can, and Sam does everything he can to help Atley achieve his goals. I cannot speak highly enough about the level of dedication Sam puts into each and every student he takes on, and I have sent several more students his way. Thank You SFT for your dedication to Atley, and everyone who steps into your facility!
name: Steve Noort

quote: Some of the things that drew me to SFT specifically were: programs tailored to me - As a mom and teacher, not having to make more decisions (as small as they may be!) was really appealing to me. Small class sizes - Things don’t get super busy so you aren’t left on your own and feel lost.Having someone there to correct my form - Having coaches there to show you the smallest change can make a huge impact (and you can really feel it). My favorite part of SFT has been the community! With small class sizes, having Sam and Fletcher guiding my workouts, and seeing familiar faces each visit, makes it easy to find the motivation to come back each time. Another thing I value is the support I get from Sam and Fletcher each time I come, whether it be a fist bump or simply acknowledging a good job. They do a great job of watching your workout and making adjustments to things as needed. It’s really helpful to have coaches who push you when needed or switch things up if the day is proving to be too rough of one. Bet on yourself and Sam will guide you along the way!
name: Jennie Knezevic
context: Deacon Oszust - Boone Grove Basketball, Baseball

quote: I decided to give SFT a try since other programs the boys have been in weren't successful. I was drawn to the different approach Coach Sam was offering. Everyone is on their own fitness journey and SFT knows that and caters a program specific to that individual’s needs. The boys have become more motivated, disciplined, and eager to go to class and set higher goals. I have noticed my boys take more interest in their fitness and see how this plays hand in hand with performance on the court and field. It is very encouraging to them when they see how much they have achieved from their evaluation.
name: Marie Oszust

quote: I joined SFT after working out for about a year on my own at the YMCA. I was at a point that I needed to be pushed harder in the gym to reach my potential, and I needed extra support to accomplish that. My favorite part of SFT is the community. I LOVE how we push each other and celebrate victories together. There is a great camaraderie among the clients and coaches and I love that. I also love the personal coaching that SFT provides. The coaching allows me to push harder while maintaining my health and safety. SFT has pushed me so far beyond what I thought was possible! SFT has continued to challenge me every day. At the end of each workout, I am a tiny bit angry that the workout was so hard, but mostly so happy I was able to accomplish it without quitting. It is scary to walk into a new gym and to do something outside of your comfort zone. Choosing SFT is an excellent decision for your health, mind and body. You will find yourself working towards, and accomplishing goals that seemed impossible at the outset. Being able to work towards those goals with a coach who is leading you and alongside other clients who are cheering you on has been tremendously fun and rewarding.
name: Bethany Knight
context: Maddie & Abby Cheranko - Crown Point High School XC, Track

quote: When I came across Strength for Today’s social media ad it caught my attention. As a parent I was looking for an off-season workout program for my daughters and needed something with a flexible schedule but also a program that would work for each of their sports. SFT fit that criteria. Both teens look forward to their weekly workouts and after one off-season they have both seen a huge improvement. Abbie is a cross-country runner and after an off-season program with SFT she beat her previous mile run by almost 1 minute in this summer’s time trial. Maddie is a golfer and after her off-season work out routine with SFT she has added over 20yds to her club distances. As we head into the girl’s season’s we are more excited than ever to see the improvements during competition. Sam and his SFT programs have boosted the girl’s confidence too with seeing these improvements.
name: Dan Cheranko

quote: Several people recommended SFT when I was looking for a new gym. Sam met with our gym crew, was very patient and answered all of our questions. I enjoy the atmosphere and the camaraderie at the gym; there is no judgment. Everyone is there doing their best and supporting one another. I have maintained my weight and created more tone and definition. I am the fittest I have been since having my children. You will not regret joining. We have a lot of fun here while working toward goals.
